reject_direct_substitution_reason.reason: Walk then stop with mismatched contact/pose endpoints, not a cyclic steady locomotion clip

runtime_alignment_proposal.physical_travel_owner: Existing CharacterMovement only; no generated root position writes or capsule scaling
runtime_alignment_proposal.phase_clock: Advance steady-loop phase from actual measured capsule planar distance against an independently measured owner-space stride-distance curve; use unwrapped phase and actual collision-limited travel, not key state or configured max speed
runtime_alignment_proposal.reference_curve_warning: Generated Hips trajectory includes pelvis sway and proportional retarget error; use smoothed source travel plus actual same-owner stance skin trajectories, not unverified model speed metadata
runtime_alignment_proposal.rate_equation: rate(t)=actual_capsule_planar_speed/reference_owner_speed(phase); zero/invalid reference speed cannot drive a steady loop
runtime_alignment_proposal.rate_safety: If required rate exceeds validated playback range, choose an appropriate captured/generated gait or blend state; do not silently clamp while claiming footplant
runtime_alignment_proposal.contact_ik: At each actual stance onset retain each heel/toe support point in world coordinates, preserve its stable anchor through that support phase, transform through measured current body world placement, and solve fixed-length legs/pelvis-Y without altering physical root/capsule
runtime_alignment_proposal.turning: Keep grounded world anchors while body turns only within measured reach; release/pivot only at explicit heel/toe support transition, never reset an active support anchor every frame
runtime_alignment_proposal.collision_stop: Blocked physical movement must stop steady walking phase and blend to Idle/Stop while stance anchors remain fixed
runtime_alignment_proposal.stairs: Ground supports and normals must come from actual collision hits per foot, not global plane0; reject unreachable supports rather than bypassing collision
